---
title: "Sharing Results & Reproducible Workflows"
description: |
  Sharing a complete, reproducible INTEGRATOR peak-integration dataset (raw data, input files,
  parameters, and results) together with the accompanying applications.
---

Because INTEGRATOR and MRMhub-viz are self-contained executables that require no installation, a
complete peak-integration dataset can be shared as a single folder, allowing others to inspect,
reproduce, and modify the raw-data processing. Beyond the CSV tables of peak areas, the raw data,
the input files with all integration parameters, and the individual integration results can be
bundled together with the applications.

## What to bundle

The components below make a shared dataset fully self-contained. The **raw data and input files**
are what is needed to re-run the processing; the **results** allow the outcome to be inspected
without re-running; and the **applications** provide the means to do either.

### Raw data and input files

| Item | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `mzML/` folder | The converted raw data on which integration is performed. |
| `param.txt` | All global parameters (tolerances, peak-width windows, RT-shift bounds, threads). |
| `run_order.csv` | The sample list, in processing order, with sample/QC types and reference-sample designations. |
| `feature_list.csv` | The transitions and features to integrate, including any per-feature overrides. |

### Results

| Item | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `long.csv` | The canonical long-format results and the hand-off to the QUANT R package. |
| `quant_raw.csv` | The wide-format table of peak areas. |
| `RT_matrix.csv` | The finalised integration borders, including any manual adjustments — required to reproduce the exact integration. |
| `misc/` folder | The binary integration results read by MRMhub-viz for interactive review. |
| PDF folders (optional) | `by_transition`, `by_transition_low`, and `by_sample` PDFs documenting the integration (see [Running INTEGRATOR — Step 4](running.qmd)). |

### Applications

| Item | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **MRMhub** (~1 MB) | The integration application, to re-run or modify any processing step. |
| **MRMhub-viz** (~10 MB) | The visualizer, to review the integration interactively (see [MRMhub-viz](viz.qmd)). |
| `MRMhub_plot.r` | The base-R script that generates the PDF results; it can be edited to tailor the plot layout. |

::: {.callout-tip}
Retaining one copy of the applications in each analysis project folder keeps the project
reproducible and self-documenting: a recipient can open MRMhub-viz to inspect every peak, or re-run
INTEGRATOR to reproduce or adjust the integration, without any installation.
:::
